reply_text:
I replied to Dana in her direct message: **send the truck to Bay 41.**

That comes from her own note to me on 14 Oct. She said Bay 41 is now her dock for Thornbury Cloth Co. pickups on the Lantern project. I found it in the workspace knowledge base under her own direct-message history, so it was fine to tell her. I didn't post it anywhere else.

A keyword search of the shared channel history and public files found nothing else about Thornbury, so nothing I could see replaces that note. That search was keyword-only, and I didn't read each channel directly. My reply suggests she check with the site before Thursday.

The knowledge base marks her 14 Oct note as visible to everyone, not just Dana. I left it as it was. Only the knowledge base owner can limit who sees it.
